contract: Follow the existing Phase 5 design contract and docs/TEXT_CONTEXT_FIX.md. Preserve the image as the reading surface, quiet green controls, readable opaque backing, safe text rendering and full Text details. Wrapped lines in one OCR paragraph become one bounded region with union geometry and natural wrapping; explicit paragraph/block boundaries keep bubbles separate. Preserve centered/left text alignment and all existing actions. Validate the supplied comic at 375x812, 768x900 and 1440x900 with actual OCR and NLLB, without hardcoded translations.

accessibility.evidence: Actual comic overlays report zero axe violations at all three viewports; the existing overlay/popup audits and keyboard control cases also pass. Target-language metadata, safe selectable text, connected detail labels and focus restoration are preserved. Rendered review confirms readable wrapped text and visible action focus. Native popup, screen reader and full assistive-technology coverage remain manual; this is not a complete WCAG claim.

responsive.evidence: Actual grouped comic captures at 375x812, 768x900 and 1440x900 were visually reviewed. One complete translated sentence wraps in its source union box. Browser numeric assertions verify matching geometry and existing fit/crop/scroll/resize/scale/zoom behavior, with no horizontal overflow in audited result layouts.

loading.evidence: The passing suite captures actual progress in overlay-loading.png and retains Cancel. It also cancels a real job by disabling its site and confirms the worker host closes.

empty.evidence: The current image regression produces ocr-empty.png for a real blank image with NO_TEXT_FOUND, Retry and Dismiss. Three first-use cases also retain readable OCR/setup guidance without downloading weights.

error.evidence: The current overlay-unsupported.png and passing layout case preserve complete original/translated text when rotation prevents mapping and restore the overlay after the layout is supported again. Existing interruption/reload regressions pass.

partial.evidence: The current crop/clipping cases retain source geometry and disclose unavailable regions. overlay-literal-long-text.png is explicitly a rendering fixture: it verifies bounded overflow with complete text available in details, without claiming model quality for synthetic input.

success.evidence: Actual OCR finds We got this / mysterious / package. in one paragraph; one NLLB request returns Kami punya paket misterius ini. Two bubbles in the next real crop remain separate, producing two requests and two union boxes. Region membership, safe text and rendered coordinates are asserted.

permission.evidence: The existing site checkbox persistence, disable/cancel and manual-reactivation scenarios pass with the new grouping code. overlay-site-disabled.png records the disabled activation state. First-use checks confirm no model download without explicit consent. Native browser grant dialogs remain manual; this change adds no permissions.
